settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Change this and the whole site follows. The name is deliberately not hard-coded anywhere — see 0-plan/18-name-clearance.md.

settings.label: One line above the masthead
settings.default: Complimentary UK delivery over £250 · International shipping
settings.info: Leave empty to hide. D13 asks for the all-in price claim in the headline.

settings.content: A piece's status comes from its tags (Products → the piece → Tags). No tag: available. Stock 0: sold, kept in the Archive. reserved: held for a client; it shows Reserved, can't be bought, and stays out of the Archive; remove the tag to sell it again. coming-soon: keep its stock at 0 and give it a Date and time metafield hikari.release; it shows the release time and never counts as sold; remove the tag and add stock when it goes live (D25). A piece in stock without a price also shows as coming soon.

settings.label: Show New for this many days after publishing
settings.info: 0 turns New off.

settings.content: In transit: tag a piece in-transit (the older tag pre-sale works too). In stock, it can be bought now: the badge says In transit, the button says Pre-order, and the note "On its way to us from Japan. Ships within N days of your order." shows on the page and goes on the order. On a coming-soon piece the note shows beside the release time. Remove the tag once it has arrived. On sale: give a product a compare-at price above its price; the old price shows struck through.

settings.label: In transit: ships within this many days
settings.info: A number or a range, such as 10–14. Promise less than you expect to deliver.

settings.content: These show in the footer and the phone menu. Empty links are hidden on the site. Fill them once the handles are secured (#57, #59).

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: With the country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123. Shows a WhatsApp button on the Contact page.

settings.label: WeChat QR code
settings.info: In WeChat: Me → your name → My QR Code, then save the image.

settings.label: Ask about this piece: email
settings.info: Leave empty to use the store's sender email. Questions go to a named inbox, not a chat widget (D9).

settings.label: Free UK delivery from (£)
settings.info: Must match Settings → Shipping and delivery (UK market). At or over this, a UK buyer's bag says delivery is free and shows a Total; under it the bag says delivery is added at checkout and shows a Subtotal (D12). 0 means always free.

settings.label: Bag notice
settings.info: One line above the total, for delivery cut-offs. E.g. Order by Thursday 18 December for Christmas delivery. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Offer a gift note
settings.info: The note reaches the order as a cart attribute, under Additional details. Someone has to write it on a card: see 1-shop/21-checkout.md.

settings.label: Gift promise
settings.default: We write your note on a card and leave the price out of the parcel.
settings.info: Only promise what is actually done when the parcel is packed.

settings.label: Trademark disclaimer
settings.info: [brand] is replaced with the brand name set above.

settings.label: Registered company name
settings.info: Required by the Companies Act and the E-Commerce Regulations 2002.

settings.label: VAT line
settings.info: Charging or displaying VAT while unregistered is an offence. Keep Settings → Taxes at zero.

settings.content: What Google shows for the home page, and what a shared link shows. Product and collection pages use their own titles and descriptions.

settings.label: Home page title
settings.info: Around 60 characters. Say what you sell, then the shop's name.

settings.label: Other names for the shop
settings.info: Shorter or other names people search for, separated by commas. Google may show one as the site name.

settings.label: Home page description
settings.info: Around 155 characters.

settings.label: Image for shared links
settings.info: Used when a page has no photograph of its own. 1200px wide or more.

settings.label: Logo for search engines
settings.info: A wide logo on a plain background.

settings.label: Google Search Console code
settings.info: Only the content="…" part of the HTML tag Search Console gives you.

settings.content: Google Analytics (G-EV92TR6CMY) and the session recordings below load only once a visitor allows analytics in the cookie banner. What visitors do is sent as events: assets/track.js.

settings.label: Microsoft Clarity project ID
settings.info: Session recordings and heatmaps (free, clarity.microsoft.com). The ID from Settings → Overview, e.g. abcd1234ef. Empty: off.
